QuestInfo.name: Pantheon in Crisis
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart has a mission for you.
QuestInfo.1: If you want to become a hero, you need to learn about the world at large. Neinheart wants you to pay Pantheon a visit.\r\nHelp the Novas, a member race of the Alliance.
QuestInfo.2: You helped the Novas reach the center of Heliseum.\r\nHelp them reclaim Heliseum entirely.\r\n
QuestInfo.demandSummary: The #bCastle Crash#k quest is complete.\r\n(You can start #bTo Pantheon#k from the lightbulb over your head.)

1.msg: The Nova of Pantheon are embroiled in a bitter war. They're also members of the Alliance. Perhaps you could keep on eye on their situation on my behalf.

2.msg: I'm trusting you, #b#h0##k, at least enough to take on this very important mission. \r\n( To start, Accept the #bTo Pantheon#k quest using the quest light bulb above your head.)

0.msg: You can get to Pantheon by taking the #bInterdimensional Portal#k in the #bSix Path Crossway#k. Why don't you talk to #bBeldar#k?\r\nGood luck.
Perhaps that trust was misplaced? Return to me if you have a change of heart.
Hey, Neinheart!\r\nWe've made it to the center of Heliseum.

1.msg: I see. The Maple Alliance would be in your debt if you could help Pantheon reclaim #bHeliseum#k.

quest.0: You still haven't completed my mission. Are you serious about joining the Maple Alliance?
